headline:
October Opens
Busy Around Here
titan_line: Echo, three things worth knowing about this week — and every one of them is still ahead of us as this goes up.

items.title: Fall Georgia State Fair
items.detail: EchoPark Speedway, 1500 Tara Place in Hampton. Rides, shows and fair food over two weekends.

items.title: FoodeesFest
items.detail: Three days of food vendors. Venue and times are on the county tourism calendar.

items.title: Pizza Cook-Off Competition
items.detail: In McDonough, from 9am to 3:30pm on the Saturday.

echo_line: Ten days of fair? …Oh — it runs across two weekends. That's the one I'd take the kids to.
source: Visit Henry County Georgia events calendar · retrieved September 24, 2026
disclaimer: Dates as published by the organisers on the date retrieved. Confirm with the event before travelling.
